capabilities: Render chat-style message bubbles in notes
Set a chat title and profile picture per block
Control bubble side with l:/r: prefixes or automatic alternating alignment
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a roadmap lists more customization options as planned.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render chat or messaging conversations as styled blocks inside a note.
summary: Chat-block renderer that turns a simple line syntax into chat-style message bubbles with titles, profile pictures, and left/right alignment.
